narrative.northStar: The good pull becomes a shared story
narrative.overview: TCG Nexus is a collectible-card community presented like a well-made wax pack: clear set information, tactile specimens, and a direct path from discovery to exchange.

rules.name: The Specimen Rule
rules.body: Every card image carries a name, set context, state, and next action.

rules.name: The Action Ink Rule
rules.body: Action red is reserved for the primary CTA, active trade moments, and availability labels.

rules.name: The Data Label Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono is reserved for card numbers, conditions, timestamps, and catalogue metadata.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Use borders, rules, and offset print shadows for structure before adding effects.

dos: Do let card content carry the visual interest.
Do keep discovery as the first action.
Do pair functional color with text or iconography.
donts: Don't copy the reference's baseball content or subscription model.
Don't turn the page into a screenshot or poster.
Don't use generic gradients or over-rounded dashboard cards.
